nodes.label: Parallel Sub-Agents Aggregation
nodes.rationale: Both axes run as parallel sub-agents so they don't pollute each other's context; findings are reported under separate headings without merge or rerank so one axis cannot mask the other.

nodes.label: Fowler Smell Baseline
nodes.rationale: Fixed set of Fowler Refactoring ch.3 smells always applies; repo-documented standards override the baseline; smells are judgement-call heuristics, never hard violations; skip anything tooling already enforces.

nodes.label: Why Two Axes Separation
nodes.rationale: A change can pass Standards and fail Spec (wrong thing, well-written) or pass Spec and fail Standards (right thing, breaks conventions); separate reporting prevents one axis from masking the other.

nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: The language model never touches the database; its capability surface is a catalogue of typed tools wrapping services that validate, authorise, and write.

nodes.label: Model Gets No Identity
nodes.rationale: teacher_id travels in tool context, not tool arguments, so the model cannot name another teacher; every repository query filters by ownership.

nodes.label: Sessions Are Database State
nodes.rationale: An attendance session is active because a row says open; conversation memory only hints which class is in focus so restarts lose nothing.

nodes.label: Buttons and Typing Share Implementation
nodes.rationale: Each attendance operation has conversational and direct entry points both delegating to the same private method so the two paths cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Strict Tool Schemas Generated
nodes.rationale: schema.py converts Pydantic into conservative JSON Schema for local LLMs; arguments are re-validated against the real model — the schema is a hint, not the enforcement boundary.

nodes.label: Open Transaction Across Model Round Trip
nodes.rationale: Database transaction stays open across the model round trip because tools need it mid-loop; fine at this scale, high-traffic would give each tool call its own session.
